issues: Confusion across the team about when VAT and deliveries should be entered into the food spend spreadsheet, which was creating inconsistent figures in the GM report and calculation errors.
Covers and sales were down year on year, although the site still exceeded its sales target for the week.
A delivery refund is under review to establish whether it should be formally challenged.
Missing items on delivery orders were traced to stock levels not being updated correctly on the point of sale, so items do not print to the kitchen.

A negative review was received about allergy accommodation; the team concluded the standard disclaimer is appropriate industry practice and that staff correctly offered a choice based on ingredient limitations rather than giving a false guarantee.
A staff member resigned because of a clash between her shift and a second job, with no replacement decision taken as the role is a single shift per week.
The ice machine has broken again and factory staff have been using it even though it is not food safety grade for factory use.
The matching promotion has not yet reached its weekly milestone and the team agreed to let the initiative run its course.
Compliance records on the Mapal system are showing red indicators because of a transition in the data collection method.

Investigate the delivery refund and determine whether it should be formally challenged - Owner: M8 (01/09/2026)
Synchronise stock levels between the point of sale and the delivery tablet, manually toggling items back to in stock so they print to the kitchen properly - Owner: M8 (01/09/2026)
Respond to the allergy review with a professional invitation for the customer to return - Owner: M8 (01/09/2026)
Inform Dean that factory staff must not use the restaurant ice machine and must arrange their own ice supply - Owner: Ka Ho (01/09/2026)
Log the ice machine fault for repair - Owner: M8 (01/09/2026)
Train new hire Inesh on manager processes including opening, cash up and service standards during a high volume period - Owner: M8 (01/09/2026)
Coordinate with Akila on the timeframe for Inesh to train at the site - Owner: Ka Ho (01/09/2026)
Complete all overdue Mapal certificates and documentation by the extended Friday deadline - Owner: M8 (28/08/2026)
Complete any outstanding training courses assigned on Flow for the older sites - Owner: M8 (28/08/2026)
Move the waste to the designated fire door area and place it outside ready for collection in the morning - Owner: M8 (26/08/2026)
Verify that the waste is collected by the team in the morning - Owner: Ka Ho (26/08/2026)
